solver.description: Plan multiple products that share one production line and raw-material stock. The optimizer prioritizes on-time units, then minimizes new material spend.
solver.extraHours: Extra hours per day for comparison
solver.strict: Require every target in full by its due day
solver.dayBasis: Day 1 starts today. Capacity repeats daily on calendar days. Orders can be used on their arrival day. Missed units remain open.
solver.capacityError: Line hours and extra hours together must be at most 24 per day.

status.optimal: The solver proved optimality for these inputs.
status.feasible: The solver found a feasible plan within the time limit. It has yet to prove optimality.
status.infeasible: The targets cannot all be met under these constraints. Allow missed units or revise the inputs.
status.no_solution: The solver reached its time limit before finding a feasible plan.
